title: Event Time, Processing Time & Watermarks
interviewAnswer: Streaming systems distinguish when an event occurred from when it was processed. Watermarks express progress in event time and let systems close windows while tolerating bounded late data.
keyPoints: Watermark policy trades completeness vs latency.
why: Event Time, Processing Time & Watermarks is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
deepDive: Streaming systems distinguish when an event occurred from when it was processed. Watermarks express progress in event time and let systems close windows while tolerating bounded late data. Watermark policy trades completeness vs latency. Window state needs cleanup. The interview-level skill is not merely recalling the definition: explain the assumptions, what diagnostic evidence you would inspect, and what alternative you would choose when those assumptions fail.
workedExample: Aggregate sensor events by the minute even when some events arrive 30 seconds late.
commonMistakes: Using the concept mechanically without checking assumptions or data semantics.
Reporting one metric/result without examining uncertainty, slices or failure modes.
